title: retro-games deployment diagram
description: Where every game runs: eight Workers on icelander.net, five with their own D1 database and MEG with a Durable Object, Gambit's Durable Objects, the services they call, the owner's computer that deploys them, and LodeStar on the pilot's own computer.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs each web game; signed in to icelander.net.

nodes.name: Pilot's computer
nodes.description: Runs LodeStar's desktop export.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge (icelander.net)
nodes.description: Runs each game's Worker on its route under icelander.net/games/retro/, and serves its static assets.

nodes.name: Owner's computer
nodes.description: Deploys each game by hand: npm run deploy in the game's folder tests it, builds it and runs wrangler deploy. Nothing deploys from GitHub.

nodes.name: lundey Worker
nodes.description: Lundey's Worker on icelander.net/games/lundey*, for holders of games:lundey only; no database. Its own deployment diagram is in games/lundey/.dev.
